This project includes the official Android skills repository as a Git submodule:

https://github.com/android/skills

Only the following subset is used:

- testing/testing-setup

The rest of the repository is not used and is kept only for provenance and reproducibility.



A restricted fraction of the testing framework is used. For this, an effective SKILL.md is derived from the reference SKILL.md:

Target restricted SKILL.md at .opencode/skills/android-testing/SKILL.md;
Derived from SKILL.md at at external/android-skills/testing/testing-setup/SKILL.md

First-time derivation is obtained via the dedicated prompt external/prompts/
